query:
select jsonb_build_object('captured_at',now(),
'locks',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(l) order by l.slate_date,l.pitcher,l.side) from public.operational_pick_locks l where l.slate_date between '2026-07-24' and '2026-09-03'),
'frozen',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',a.id,'slate_date',a.slate_date,'pitcher',a.pitcher,'normalized_pitcher',a.normalized_pitcher,'side',a.side,'game_time',a.game_time,'selection_status',a.selection_status,'lane',a.lane,'lock_dedupe_key',a.lock_dedupe_key,'official_verdict',a.official_verdict,'official_odds',a.official_odds,'model_k_line',a.model_k_line,'normalized_inputs',a.evaluation_proof->'normalized_inputs','provider',a.evaluation_proof#>'{candidate,line_source_provider}') order by a.slate_date,a.pitcher,a.side) from public.alternative_pick_selection_state a where a.bundle_id='pregame_alternative_pick_methodology_v2' and a.checkpoint='frozen_pregame' and a.slate_date between '2026-07-24' and '2026-09-03')) as evidence
